description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, providing REST API endpoints for managing employee work experience records. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting work experience entries, as well as validation rules and dependency management.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI
